messages:
elaine: Quick PR incoming to trim the hello quickstart: make the auth step a single export line, add a tiny Rust example (asked by community), and fix a bad deploy anchor. will link PR when ready.

omar: Rust example? neat. keep it one-liner or folks will copy a ton. also please keep curl first for maximum copy-paste.

elaine: yep — curl single-line, then JS, then the new Rust one-liner. curl: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood/fast-qa","prompt":"Hey"}'`

violet: tiny nit: add `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` and a short sentence about default token scopes for new orgs. saves a lot of support tickets.

elaine: added export line and a note about "starter" scope needed for quickstarts.

ken: for the Rust snippet, keep it to one HTTP call example using reqwest so users can paste: `let res = reqwest::blocking::Client::new().post("https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate").bearer_auth(std::env::var("REDWOOD_API_KEY").unwrap()).json(&serde_json::json!({"model":"redwood/fast-qa","prompt":"Hi"})).send()?;`

omar: can you also add a one-line about pinning a model for Dedicated customers (`model: redwood/fast-qa@v1.2.0`) and link to rollout docs? tempo: just a short note.

elaine: done. also adding a 1-sentence troubleshooting section for CORS on first deploy and a GH Actions snippet reminder not to echo secrets.

docs-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4410 — title: "Hello quickstart: slim auth + curl/js/rust + anchor fix" (author: elaine)

violet: i'll review wording and the privacy line for telemetry opt-in. aim to approve before the site build later today.

ken: reviewing now. will leave inline comments about reqwest unwrap example and suggest a slightly safer variant.

elaine: thanks all ":thumbsup:" — merging after quick fixes unless anyone objects.
